mainEntity.name: How close is your showroom to Vaughan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Very close. We're at 17380 Highway 27 in Schomberg, just north of Vaughan. Visits are by appointment.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a backyard sauna in Vaughan?

acceptedAnswer.text: An accessory building over 10 m² typically needs a building permit, zoning setbacks apply, and the electrical connection needs an ESA permit. We check your model and lot before you order.

mainEntity.name: Can a Vaughan sauna be wood-burning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, on our larger saunas like the Neptune, Avalon and larger barrels. Check your insurer's requirements for wood stoves first.

mainEntity.name: How much does delivery and installation cost in Vaughan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delivery and installation is $1,750 anywhere in Ontario, including Vaughan. Delivery only is $450. HST is shown separately on every quote.

mainEntity.name: What heater size does my sauna need?

acceptedAnswer.text: We size every heater to the sauna's interior volume plus extra for glass. None of our saunas take less than a 6 kW heater; larger models use 9 to 10.5 kW electric or a wood stove where there's room for its clearances.
